title: Prospective Multivariate Search-State Atlas, Outcome-Blind Cross-Architecture Coordinate Alignment, Quotient-Refinement Ceiling, Intervention-Response Bisimulation & Architecture-Indexed Causal Law Constitution

literature_design_constraints.representation_similarity: CCA/SVCCA/PWCCA/CKA/RSA motivate separating representational from functional agreement; P24 does not treat representational alignment as causal evidence.
literature_design_constraints.multiway_alignment: Multi-way alignment motivates a shared reference rather than pairwise maps; P24 uses an engine-symmetric empirical-copula universe rather than a learned pairwise map.
literature_design_constraints.causal_abstraction: Causal abstraction and interchange-intervention work motivate intervention-level faithfulness rather than observational similarity alone.
literature_design_constraints.nonlinear_map_defeater: The 2025 nonlinear-representation dilemma motivates a deliberately low-capacity, frozen alignment family; no outcome-trained nonlinear map is permitted.
literature_design_constraints.state_dependent_models: Combined causal-model work motivates input/state-conditioned laws while preserving a strength-vs-faithfulness distinction.
literature_design_constraints.bisimulation: Classical partition refinement and causal/state-abstraction work motivate a coarsest response-equivalence quotient rather than post-hoc narrative similarity.
literature_design_constraints.chess_xai_boundary: Existing chess interpretability work primarily probes concepts or controls neural-model information flow; P24 instead intervenes on persistent search-memory mechanisms in multiple classical engine architectures and adjudicates exact-world causal response transport.

outcome_blind_atlas.alignment: within each material-family x side stratum and each engine, convert TOTAL_READS and Q_SHARE to average-tie empirical-copula ranks; aggregate the three engines by coordinate-wise median
outcome_blind_atlas.disagreement: coordinate-wise max-minus-min rank spread; joint disagreement is the mean of TOTAL and Q_SHARE spreads
outcome_blind_atlas.why_not_cca_or_gpa: the observed engine telemetry has named mechanistic coordinates, tiny per-stratum support, and architecture-specific marginal scales; a rank-copula map is monotone-invariant, low-capacity, auditable, and cannot rotate named mechanisms into an outcome-fitted latent basis

nested_refinement.K2: within each 24-cell family-side stratum, balanced split by consensus Q_SHARE rank (12/12)
nested_refinement.K4: within each K2 block, balanced split by consensus TOTAL rank (6/6)
nested_refinement.K8: within each K4 block, balanced split by joint cross-architecture disagreement (3/3)

interventions.primary_outcome: fine exact-world value change inherited from P20-P23

quotient_refinement_court.per_level_test: for every atlas-state x ontological-square, compute the inherited P20 response fingerprint independently for each engine
quotient_refinement_court.strict_architecture_invariance: all three full fingerprints equal in every state x square cell
quotient_refinement_court.strict_conditional_naturality: all three engine pairs satisfy inherited P20 compatible() in every state x square cell
quotient_refinement_court.p20_relation_recovery: HEAVY_HEAVY must be CURVED/QSEARCH/-1 in all three engines within a state; MINOR_MINOR must not collapse to the same common curved fingerprint
quotient_refinement_court.ceiling_rule: If no K in {1,2,4,8} yields universal strict architecture invariance or universal conditional naturality, and K8 still contains architecture-splitting response classes, declare FROZEN_ATLAS_QUOTIENT_REFINEMENT_CEILING_REACHED. This ceiling is relative to the presealed rank-copula atlas family, intervention algebra, engine set, world family, and budgets; it is not a theorem over arbitrary representations.

intervention_response_bisimulation.observations: ordered pair of HEAVY_HEAVY and MINOR_MINOR full response fingerprints
intervention_response_bisimulation.equivalence: two nodes are response-bisimilar iff their complete predeclared observation signatures are identical; compute the coarsest exact partition
intervention_response_bisimulation.architecture_free_success: for every K8 state, Stockfish 19, Berserk and Ethereal occupy one common response-equivalence block
intervention_response_bisimulation.architecture_index_necessity: at least one K8 state is split by engine identity after outcome-blind state alignment

architecture_indexed_law.constitute_if: architecture-free bisimulation fails but each engine has a reproducible nonconstant state-indexed response law under the same frozen atlas

negative_controls_and_fail_closed: Inanis PAWN_Q must produce zero fine-value changes.
Fresh-world cardinality, binary identity, atlas cardinality and nested 24/12/6/3 quotas must all pass before selective outcomes are opened.
No outcome-trained alignment, threshold, clustering, engine weighting, feature selection or state relabeling is permitted.
Any K8 family-side state must contain exactly three cells; otherwise abort.
WDL is secondary and cannot replace fine exact-world value.
